verdict.rationale: The firm's own late-stage company page says it has "deep expertise helping private companies achieve the best possible M&A outcomes" and describes IPO preparation starting two years ahead. A separate D&O Questionnaire Portal page supports companies going public and operating as public companies. Its client news includes exit-scale work such as the $12.9B Hugging Face sale to NVIDIA, though that representation was investor-side. Missing for 10: a dedicated M&A or IPO/capital-markets practice page with quantified exit track record, company-side exit deal examples, and independent corroboration of exit capability.
